entry_state: Timely and late treaties can reach the same final cash with different recognition histories. Munich Re's disclosed future acquisition outflows, service recovery and expense are distinct populations and dates; their differences do not identify a paid acquisition asset. Its CSM bridge reconciles while PAA remaining coverage explains specified table-scope differences. Ping An's original and restated2022 balances must both survive; comparable growth uses the restated basis. Adoption,economic date,board authorization and public availability are different facts. Actual transition reconstruction still needs group measurements and classifications.
exit_state: Transition methods require group-specific eligibility and information. A later estimate is not automatically hindsight,but later outcomes cannot replace contemporaneous expectations in full retrospection. Fair value of the insurance group differs from its investments and from FCF. Full and modified routes may produce different margins from the same cash. Prescribed nil acquisition or recovery components do not erase paid cash or ordinary treaty value. In the stated fair-value transition case C=max(V-F,0),K=max(F-V,0),and liability=max(F,V),with K inside the liability. Section12.26 continues after330 with opening equity.

findings.observation: The transition discussion distinguishes methods,source jurisdictions and information permissions before numerical examples. The C5A exception prevents fair-value choice being treated as proof of impracticability.
The examples preserve identical cash while showing different admissible information can change CSM. Prescribed nil components are narrowly scoped.
The two-sign fair-value case shows that a loss component is within FCF,whereas CSM is added;the method name does not imply every resulting liability equals fair value.
